Shall not constitute the main source of nitrogen in the absence of complimentary and additional nitrogen generating practices on farm and shall not be from conventional intensive livestock production systems without prior permission from the control body Coming from extensive livestock farming. If sourced from intensive livestock farming or not sourced from organic production systems, then the need for use thereof shall be motivated to the certification body, and it shall be composted. Forbidden if from factory farming origin.
